row:
Hey! Thanks for stopping by our channel!

Here you'll find videos on trimming and shoeing horses, forging handmade horseshoes, therapeutic horseshoeing, tips and tricks for other farriers, and some veterinary cases.

My name is Sheldon Thomas. I am a Veterinarian and Certified Journeyman Farrier with the American Farrier's Association. I was born and raised in a small town in Southeastern Arizona, USA. I am currently working as a mixed animal veterinarian in Washington and keep busy horseshoeing on the side. Between that and spending time with my family, my time is pretty well spoken for. My wife and I have been married for seven years and we have three little boys. 

Ride like the wind and God bless!
